notes.title: The war is coming! Get to know our game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45151214/72ac09c9505309700f217c518f7817c5e97e6e88.png[/img]

Destiny of Heroes is a Twin-stick Shooter game set during the war in Indonesia in 1942-1949 which we developed and published by our partner indie.io

Our goal in making this game is to introduce history from the Asian side, because so far the historical games that are scattered out there only show the European side.

We believe that freedom is the right of all nations and countries. Therefore, with Destiny of Heroes, we want to show that peace is the most needed thing by humans.

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

Steam publisher page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio[/url]


Follow us on our socials, join our Discord, and be sure to wishlist the game to stay up to date with future news! Because with your support and input, we will make this game even better :)

- Nexvel Entertainment Team
